description: Search live veterinary job listings on VetJobs.au, Australia's dedicated veterinary job board: veterinarian, veterinary nurse, locum, practice manager, reception and animal care roles posted by clinics, hospitals and practices across Australia (plus some New Zealand roles), with no recruiter middlemen. Expired listings are never returned; a listing that is gone from the source disappears from results. Each listing reports provenance: source, is_imported, first_party, employer_feed and source_url. first_party is how the listing reached us (the employer posted it directly or an approved ad was placed on its behalf) and is therefore a conservative subset: genuine employer ads imported from an employer's own ATS feed are also marked imported, so is_imported alone does not mean an ad was scraped. employer_feed says it was read from that feed; imported is not a synonym for untrustworthy, so the subset safest to cite is first_party=true OR employer_feed=true.

category.description: Occupation slug. Call list_categories first for the vocabulary and live counts, e.g. veterinary-nurse, veterinarian-small-animal.

employer_feed.description: true = only listings read from the employer's own careers feed (an ATS board); these are genuine employer ads even though an importer created the row. Combine with first_party=true to cover both kinds of genuine inventory. false = only rows not from an employer feed. Omit for both.

employment_type.description: FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, LOCUM_TENENS, CASUAL, CONTRACTOR, TEMPORARY, RESIDENCY, INTERNSHIP, VOLUNTEER or OTHER.

first_party.description: true = only listings deliberately posted by the employer or placed on its behalf (first_party); this is the conservative subset, and it omits auto-imported employer feeds (genuine employer ads from an ATS board — see employer_feed). false = only imports. Omit for both.

new_graduates_accepted.description: true = only listings that say they accept new graduates (graduate-friendly roles); false = only listings that do not. Omit for both.

q.description: Free-text search over title, employer, location and description.

state.description: Australian state/territory code, e.g. QLD, NSW, VIC.

updated_since.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime. Returns only listings changed since then — use this for incremental sync instead of re-fetching everything.
